title: RouteIQNative plugin payloads
description: What crosses the bridge between the web app and the iPhone shell's Swift plugin RouteIQNative (src/device/native/plugin.ts). Events: fix, locationError, tick (no payload, about once a second while the location stream is on), appState. Calls: httpGet (to https://api.mapbox.com/ only) and its answer. A value the phone does not know is left out.

fix.title: NativeFix
fix.description: The 'fix' event, and the answer to getCurrentPosition.

timestamp.description: When the phone took the fix, milliseconds since 1970.

locationError.title: NativeLocationError
locationError.description: The 'locationError' event. 'denied', or anything else for no position right now.

appState.description: The 'appState' event. Anything but these three is read as unknown.

httpGetResponse.description: Any HTTP status resolves; no answer rejects with one of httpGetErrorCode.
